description.en: Plays a technique/skill cutscene (a "waza" animation) on the given map, disabling the map/camera pause bit and the goal-mouse model for its duration, then restoring them once the cutscene finishes.
Technique/skill ID whose cutscene to play.
Technique map to use for the cutscene.
Production/quality level flag for the cutscene.
Whether the technique succeeds in the cutscene.
Whether to mirror/reverse the technique map.
Optional; whether to auto-fade out at the end (defaults to true).
Optional; whether to skip the technique name telop/caption (defaults to false).
Optional camera-cut variant to use (defaults to -1).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
